verdict.rationale: Typesense is documented as an open-source search engine that can be downloaded and run locally or on any server, with first-party install paths for Docker, Docker Compose, Kubernetes, Homebrew, DEB/RPM packages, Linux binaries, WSL and a Terraform module. The docs also cover production best practices, and the open-source server includes Raft-based high availability. Typesense Cloud is described as the hosted version of the same open-source product, so self-hosting is the core offering. Missing for 10: independent hands-on reports of running a self-hosted production deployment (community items only mention intent to try it or the readability of the C++ source).
